sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent Unity 2D animal movement sprite atlas.
Use the supplied image as identity and palette reference. Preserve species, body markings and distinctive silhouette. Render polished readable painted pixel-art with crisp contours matching the survival game, no photorealistic background.
Output exactly ONE SQUARE sheet with a 3-column by 3-row grid of NINE equally sized cells. Columns left to right: directly FRONT facing screen down; directly BACK facing screen up; true RIGHT SIDE PROFILE facing screen right. Rows top to bottom: neutral idle pose; movement pose A; opposite movement pose B. This is the SAME animal in all nine cells, identical anatomy, markings, body size and viewpoint across poses. Front and rear are genuine different drawings, not flipped copies. Slightly elevated orthographic game camera, no isometric diagonal turn, no horizon. Natural animal proportions, not human or bipedal chibi. All quadrupeds have exactly four legs, no extra paws.
Use generous EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTERS and 12% clear margins INSIDE EVERY cell so antlers, tusks, ears, tail, feathers and ALL paws stay fully inside their own cell. No clipping or shared parts between cells. Keep scale and body center consistent so frame swaps do not wobble. Each cell is a separate complete animal.
Real transparent alpha background, absolutely no floor, ground shadow, aura, labels, letters, grid lines, scenery, UI or watermark.
Identity: a slender brown deer with branching antlers, cream throat and belly, thin dark hooves; retain its recognizable antlers and proportions.
Movement: natural deer trotting, diagonal legs alternating, not hopping.

sources.refinement_prompt: Edit this hawk animation atlas. Keep exactly the same brown/cream hawk identity and 3-column/3-row arrangement: front, back, right profile; neutral glide, upstroke, downstroke. Fix the crowding and cropped wing tips. Redraw ALL nine complete birds SMALLER, at only 65 percent of the width and height of their individual equal square cells. This means a wide empty transparent margin on all four sides of EVERY bird, including top-left wings that currently touch the canvas edge. At least 15 percent of every cell is empty margin at left and right. Whole feather tips visible, no cropping, no part touches any cell boundary or the outer image edge. Keep the body chest center at the exact same relative location inside every cell across rows. Wings rise or fall around that fixed body; don't move the body up and down between rows. True FRONT and BACK in columns1 and2, RIGHT profile column3. Do not add more birds, labels, floor, outlines of panels, shadows or scenery. Transparent alpha background. Crisp painted pixel-art style of source. Output one square 3x3 sprite atlas with generous blank gutters.

slicing: Alpha-gutter bounds inspected without painting changes. Unity slices and pads to a common canvas.

hawk.anchor_note: Per-pose breast anchors measured by visual inspection; wings do not define flight pivot.
